doc: Keepsakes journal (SPEC.md §7.11, docs/lore/SLICE.md §7, docs/lore/LOWE.md §7, docs/lore/KETTLE.md §7). A thread starts when its first step's flag is set; the journal shows every step whose flag is set, in step order. Lines are verbatim from SLICE.md, LOWE.md and KETTLE.md.

steps.line: Ingra is a sack of rye short and blames a dog.
The rye was in the byre, under the dog. It had been his bed.
Ingra said he was a good dog.
Ingra is counting bowls.
Brede lost a cork float off the herring net.
The float was in the ice, where the tide stopped.
Brede says the wrong knot on the back makes it lucky.
Brede is mending the net himself.
Hesk dropped his good tongs in the bog, raking for iron.
The tongs were frozen into the bog, jaws down.
Hesk said they were never that good, and took them.
Hesk says the wind has come right.
Aud ties heather on Orm's mound every evening, the last one on the road.
Orm's cord was in the first barrow on the road.
Aud says Orm tied his knots too tight to read.
Aud has moved her heather to the first mound. She says it was always there.
Ivo is harnessing the dogs and says he is not going anywhere.
The supper was still on the hook. The ladle was frozen standing up in it.
The mitten was in the ice where the hole had been, palm up.
Ivo put the mitten on. Both of his are his own now.
Halla keeps her cargo on a knot-cord and says every knot on it is hers.
Halla's cord was tied to the mooring post. There was a knot at the end in another hand.
Halla read the last knot and called Sten over, and then told him to stay where he was.
Halla has put Sten by the fire in the end house.
